description: Groups of information services, users, and systems are not segregated in networks. This signal indicates that network segmentation is not implemented to separate different security zones, business functions, or trust levels, potentially allowing unrestricted lateral movement and access.
applicability: Applicable to all network environments including physical networks, virtual networks, cloud networks, data center networks, and wireless networks. Includes separation of production/development/test environments, user/server networks, trusted/untrusted zones, and different business units or security classifications.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through network architecture review, VLAN configuration analysis, firewall rule assessment, subnet design evaluation, cloud network configuration review, and micro-segmentation policy inspection. May also be identified through network mapping and traffic flow analysis.
